name: Drowned Dead
description: Drowned dead are larger, stronger drowner variants that stalk riverbanks and lakeshores among packs of their lesser kin.
story: Simple folk see no difference between a drowner and the drowned dead. At close range, the difference becomes fatal.
lore: These post-Conjunction predators are not drowned humans returned from the grave. They are fast, poison-resistant pack hunters adapted to filthy water, and the most robust among them often drives the entire group into an attack.
